summary: The bundle SHA256 matches the supplied hash, checkout evidence pins the requested candidate, and the frozen test evidence passes. The candidate does not honor the configured HTTP bind address during launch, so configuration-driven startup is incomplete.
findings: In tools/deploy_twin.sh, AISOC_HTTP_BIND is loaded from configuration and reported by --status, but the ui-gateway launch commands pass only --port and --static-dir. A configuration requesting a specific bind address therefore cannot control the listener and status may report an address the service is not using. The frozen lifecycle run used 0.0.0.0, so it does not expose this mismatch; honor the configured bind address and cover a non-default bind setting.
accepted_scope: 921600/460800/115200 baud support and invalid-baud rejection; manifest schema validation; and background deploy_twin.sh build, configuration loading and CLI override, sim startup/status/stop/recovery, hardware missing-UART preflight, and health-check-failure cleanup. Physical UART HIL and interactive --foreground mode are excluded.
unexecuted: Physical hardware UART HIL is not demonstrated by software or PTY evidence and is explicitly excluded from this task scope.
Interactive --foreground exec mode is explicitly excluded.
A non-default AISOC_HTTP_BIND configuration was not exercised; the launch path currently does not pass that setting to ui-gateway.
